plugins.prepareCmd: npm pkg set version=${nextRelease.version} --prefix apps/extension && bun run zip && bun run zip:firefox && if [ "${branch.type}" = prerelease ]; then git checkout HEAD -- apps/extension/package.json CHANGELOG.md; fi

plugins.publishCmd: if [ -n "$CHROME_EXTENSION_ID" ]; then cd apps/extension && bunx wxt submit --chrome-zip .output/open-browser-translate-${nextRelease.version}-chrome.zip; else echo 'CHROME_EXTENSION_ID is not set; skipping the Chrome Web Store.'; fi
